I've reviewed the current board architecture. Here's what I found and what I propose.

---

## 1. Direct Recommendation

Model a **Sprint as a board with `type: 'sprint'`** where the columns are **fixed** (not user-defined) and derive from the canonical status order already defined in the app — `todo → doing → onhold → done → rejected`. Add a `sprints: List[str]` field to the `Chat` model so a chat can belong to one or more sprints, and reuse the existing `KanbanBoardView` shell (view switcher → sidebar → canvas → modals) with a dedicated **sprint canvas** where *dragging a card between columns writes `chat.status`*.

> ⚠️ **Important distinction from the current board:** in the normal Kanban board, moving a card writes `chat.column`. In a **Sprint** board, the columns **are** the statuses, so moving a card writes `chat.status` (and keeps `chat.column` untouched). This is the key behavioural difference to review.

### Specifications

| Dimension | Decision |
| :--- | :--- |
| Board discriminator | `board.type = 'sprint'` (existing boards stay untyped → treated as `'kanban'`) |
| Columns | Fixed, ordered: `todo, doing, onhold, done, rejected` (from `CHAT_STATUS_CONFIG`) |
| Column source | `$storex.chats.statusList` — single source of truth, no drifting |
| Membership | `chat.sprints: string[]` (board ids). A chat can appear in **multiple** sprints |
| New task | `sprints = [activeSprintId]`, `status = 'todo'`, lands in **To Do** |
| Add existing | Adds `activeSprintId` to `chat.sprints`; card appears in its **current** status column |
| Drag between columns | `updateChatInfo(chat, { status })` |
| Board view shell | Reuse `KanbanBoardView` (tabs: Board / Planning / Follow-up) + `KanbanBoardModals` |

### Target Files (plan for after review)

| File | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `api/codx/junior/db.py` | **Modify** — add `sprints` to `Chat` |
| `mockups/sprint-board-mockup.html` | **Create** — reviewable mockup |
| `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue` *(later)* | Create — sprint shell |
| `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardCanvas.vue` *(later)* | Create — status columns + DnD |
| `src/components/kanban/board/SprintAddTasksModal.vue` *(later)* | Create — add existing tasks |
| `src/store/kanban.js` *(later)* | Modify — `board.type`, `addTasksToSprint`, `createSprintBoard` |
| `src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardSidebar.vue` *(later)* | Modify — build boards with `type: 'sprint'` |

Anti-pattern to avoid: **do not** seed the sprint board with user-editable columns — that reopens the "status vs column" ambiguity the model is designed to remove.

  { value: 'doing',    label: 'Doing',    icon: 'fa-solid fa-circle-play',   text: 'text-primary', border: 'border-l-primary', soft: 'bg-primary/10' },
  { value: 'onhold',   label: 'On Hold',  icon: 'fa-solid fa-circle-pause',  text: 'text-warning', border: 'border-l-warning', soft: 'bg-warning/10' },
  { value: 'done',     label: 'Done',     icon: 'fa-solid fa-circle-check',  text: 'text-success', border: 'border-l-success', soft: 'bg-success/10' },

]

const PRIORITY = {

  activeSprintId: 'sprint-12',
  tasks: [
    { id: 't1', name: 'Design login screen',        status: 'todo',     sprints: ['sprint-12'],          mode: 'chat', priority: 'high',   assignees: ['ana'],   subTasks: 2, updatedAt: '2026-01-08T10:00:00Z', board: 'Auth' },

const statusMeta = value => STATUSES.find(s => s.value === value) || STATUSES[0]

}

function candidateTasks() {
  const q = state.candidateSearch.trim().toLowerCase()
  return state.tasks
    .filter(t => !t.sprints.includes(state.activeSprintId))
    .filter(t => !q || t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
}

  $('#sprint-name').textContent = s.title
  $('#board-title').textContent = s.title

            <span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-warning/15 text-warning flex items-center gap-1">

        <span class="text-[10px] text-base-content/35">${fmtDate(task.updatedAt)}</span>
      </div>
    </article>`
}
// small alias to avoid a typo-prone inline expression
function MODERATE_ICON(mode) { return MODE_ICON[mode] || MODE_ICON.chat }

function renderBoard() {

  board.innerHTML = STATUSES.map(col => {
    const tasks = tasksInStatus(col.value)
    const cards = tasks.map(cardHtml).join('')
    return `

          <span class="text-xs font-semibold flex-1 truncate">${col.label}</span>

  }).join('')
}

function renderAll() {
  renderSprintMenu()
  renderHeader()
  renderBoard()
}

// ─── Candidate (add existing) list ───────────────────────────────────────────
function renderCandidates() {
  const list = candidateTasks()

    return `

}

// ─── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function moveTaskStatus(taskId, status) {
  const task = state.tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId)
  if (!task || task.status === status) return
  const from = statusMeta(task.status).label
  task.status = status
  task.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString()
  renderAll()
  toast(`"${task.name}" · ${from} → ${statusMeta(status).label}`, 'success')
}

function addExistingTasks() {
  const ids = [...state.selectedCandidates]
  if (!ids.length) { toast('Select at least one task', 'warning'); return }
  ids.forEach(id => {
    const t = state.tasks.find(x => x.id === id)
    if (t && !t.sprints.includes(state.activeSprintId)) t.sprints.push(state.activeSprintId)
  })
  state.selectedCandidates.clear()
  renderAll()
  toast(`Added ${ids.length} task(s) to ${activeSprint().title}`, 'success')

function createTask(name) {
  const trimmed = name?.trim()
  if (!trimmed) { toast('Task name is required', 'warning'); return }
  state.tasks.push({
    id: 't' + Date.now(),
    name: trimmed,
    status: 'todo',                        // ← always starts in To Do
    sprints: [state.activeSprintId],       // ← joins the active sprint
    mode: 'chat',
    priority: 'medium',
    assignees: [],
    subTasks: 0,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    board: '—'
  })
  renderAll()
  toast(`"${trimmed}" created in To Do`, 'success')
}

function openModal(id) {
  const el = $(`#${id}`)
  el.classList.remove('hidden')
  el.classList.add('flex')
}
function closeModal(id) {
  const el = $(`#${id}`)
  el.classList.add('hidden')
  el.classList.remove('flex')
}

// ─── Toast ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function toast(text, kind = 'info') {
  const tone = { success: 'alert-success', warning: 'alert-warning', info: 'alert-info', error: 'alert-error' }[kind] || 'alert-info'
  const node = document.createElement('div')
  node.className = `alert ${tone} alert-sm shadow-lg text-xs max-w-xs`
  node.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info text-xs"></i><span>${text}</span>`
  $('#toast').appendChild(node)
  setTimeout(() => node.remove(), 2600)
}

// ─── Wiring ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Sprint selection
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const sprint = e.target.closest('[data-sprint]')
  if (sprint) {
    state.activeSprintId = sprint.dataset.sprint
    state.selectedCandidates.clear()
    renderAll()
    document.activeElement?.blur()
  }

  // Close buttons for modals
  const closer = e.target.closest('[data-close]')
  if (closer) closeModal(closer.dataset.close)

  // Per-column "New Task"
  const newIn = e.target.closest('[data-new-in]')
  if (newIn) {
    openModal('modal-new-task')
    setTimeout(() => $('#new-task-name')?.focus(), 50)
  }
})

// Search
document.addEventListener('input', e => {
  if (e.target.id === 'search') { state.search = e.target.value; renderBoard() }
  if (e.target.id === 'candidate-search') { state.candidateSearch = e.target.value; renderCandidates() }

  // Candidate checkbox
  const cb = e.target.closest('[data-candidate]')
  if (cb) {
    const id = cb.dataset.candidate
    cb.checked ? state.selectedCandidates.add(id) : state.selectedCandidates.delete(id)
    renderCandidates()
  }
})

// Toolbar buttons
$('#btn-new-task').addEventListener('click', () => {
  openModal('modal-new-task')
  setTimeout(() => $('#new-task-name')?.focus(), 50)
})
$('#btn-add-existing').addEventListener('click', () => {
  state.selectedCandidates.clear()
  state.candidateSearch = ''
  $('#candidate-search').value = ''
  renderCandidates()
  openModal('modal-add-existing')
})

// Modal confirmations
$('#confirm-new-task').addEventListener('click', () => {
  createTask($('#new-task-name').value)
  $('#new-task-name').value = ''
  closeModal('modal-new-task')
})
$('#new-task-name').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') $('#confirm-new-task').click()
})
$('#confirm-add-existing').addEventListener('click', () => {
  addExistingTasks()
  closeModal('modal-add-existing')
})

// ── Drag & drop: moving a card writes status ──────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
  const card = e.target.closest('[data-task-id]')
  if (!card) return
  state.draggedTaskId = card.dataset.taskId
  card.classList.add('dragging')
  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'
})

document.addEventListener('dragend', e => {
  const card = e.target.closest('[data-task-id]')
  card?.classList.remove('dragging')
  document.querySelectorAll('.col-drop-active').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('col-drop-active'))
})

document.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
  const zone = e.target.closest('[data-drop-col]')
  if (!zone || state.draggedTaskId === null) return
  e.preventDefault()
  e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move'
  document.querySelectorAll('.col-drop-active').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('col-drop-active'))
  zone.classList.add('col-drop-active')
})

document.addEventListener('drop', e => {
  const zone = e.target.closest('[data-drop-col]')
  if (!zone) return
  e.preventDefault()
  const status = zone.dataset.dropCol
  if (state.draggedTaskId) moveTaskStatus(state.draggedTaskId, status)
  state.draggedTaskId = null
  document.querySelectorAll('.col-drop-active').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('col-drop-active'))
})

// ─── Boot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
renderAll()
</script>

MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES = MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_MB * 1024 * 1024


class ChatAttachment(BaseModel):
    """Represents an image stored in chat or message with file metadata and base64 data."""
    file_name: str = Field(description="Original file name of the image")
    file_type: str = Field(description="MIME type (e.g., 'image/png', 'image/jpeg')")

    @validator('file_type')
    def validate_file_type(cls, v):
        allowed_types = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/jpg', 'image/gif', 'image/webp', 'image/svg+xml']

- A **Sprint board** = a board with `type: 'sprint'`, whose columns are **fixed** and derived from the canonical `status` order (`todo → doing → onhold → done → rejected`) via `$storex.chats.statusList`.

1. Persist `sprints` on the backend `Chat` model (round-trips through the existing `/api/chats/metadata` and `PUT /api/chats`).

import { getterTree, mutationTree, actionTree } from 'typed-vuex'
import { $storex } from '.'
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'

export const namespaced = true

export const state = () => ({
  activeBoard: null,
  filter: null,
  loadingChats: 0,
})

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getKanban(project) {
  const targetProject = project || $storex.projects.activeProject
  return targetProject?.$state?.kanban || { boards: {} }
}

function getActiveProject(project) {
  return project || $storex.projects.activeProject
}

// ─── Getters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const getters = getterTree(state, {
  kanban: () => getKanban(),

  rawBoards: () => {
    const { boards = {} } = getKanban()
    return Object.keys(boards).reduce((acc, id) => {
      acc[id] = { ...boards[id], id, title: id, type: boards[id]?.type || 'kanban' }
      return acc
    }, {})
  },

  allBoards: (_, getters) => {
    const { boards = {} } = getters.kanban
    return Object.keys(boards)
      .filter(title => boards[title] !== null)
      .map(title => ({
        ...boards[title],
        id: title,
        title,
        // Boards are 'kanban' unless explicitly created as a 'sprint'
        type: boards[title]?.type || 'kanban'
      }))
  },

  activeBoard: (state, getters) => {
    return getters.rawBoards[state.activeBoard] || null
  },

  activeKanbanBoard: (state, getters) => {
    if (!state.activeBoard) return null
    return getters.allBoards.find(b => b.id === state.activeBoard) || null
  },

  boardChats: (state) => {
    const allChats = Object.values($storex.chats.chats || {})
    return allChats
      .filter(c => c.board === state.activeBoard)
      .map(c => ({ ...c, column: c.column || '--none--' }))
  },

  columnList: (state, getters) => {
    const kanbanColumns = getters.activeKanbanBoard?.columns?.map(c => c.title) || []
    const chatColumns = getters.boardChats.map(c => c.column)
    return [...new Set([...kanbanColumns, ...chatColumns])]
  },

  viewColumns: (state, getters) => {
    return getters.buildViewColumns(null)
  },

  buildViewColumns: (state, getters) => (filterText) => {
    const board = getters.activeKanbanBoard
    const columnChats = board?.columns?.chats || []

    const getChatIndex = (c) => columnChats.findIndex(kc => kc.id === c.id)

    const builtColumns = getters.columnList.map((col, ix) => {
      const storeColumn = board?.columns?.find(bc => bc.title === col) || {}
      const tasks = getters.boardChats
        .filter(t => t.column === col)
        .sort((a, b) => {
          // Respect explicit sort_index if present, then fall back to pinned / chat index
          if (a.sort_index !== undefined && b.sort_index !== undefined) {
            return a.sort_index - b.sort_index
          }
          return a.pinned || getChatIndex(a) < getChatIndex(b) ? -1 : 1
        })

      const filtered = filterText
        ? tasks.filter(task =>
            Object.keys(task)
              .reduce((acc, k) => `${acc} ${JSON.stringify(task[k])}`, '')
              .toLowerCase()
              .includes(filterText.toLowerCase())
          )
        : tasks

      return {
        id: storeColumn.id || col,
        title: col,
        color: storeColumn.color || null,
        showSubTasks: storeColumn.showSubTasks,
        project_id: storeColumn.project_id || null,
        valid: !!storeColumn.id,
        position: ix,
        project: $storex.projects.allProjectsById[storeColumn.project_id] || null,
        tasks: filtered
      }
    }).sort((a, b) => (a.position < b.position ? -1 : 1))

    return builtColumns
  },

  // ── Sprint boards ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // A sprint is a board with type === 'sprint'. Its columns are FIXED and come
  // from CHAT_STATUS_CONFIG order (see chats store) — they are the task status.

  sprintBoards: (_, getters) =>
    getters.allBoards.filter(b => b.type === 'sprint'),

  activeBoardType: (state, getters) =>
    getters.activeKanbanBoard?.type || 'kanban',

  isSprintBoard: (state, getters) =>
    getters.activeKanbanBoard?.type === 'sprint',

  // Tasks that belong to the active sprint (chat.sprints includes the board id)
  sprintBoardChats: (state) => {
    const boardId = state.activeBoard
    if (!boardId) return []
    const allChats = Object.values($storex.chats.chats || {})
    return allChats
      .filter(c => (c.sprints || []).includes(boardId))
      .map(c => ({ ...c, status: c.status || 'todo' }))
  },

  // One column per task status, following the canonical status order
  sprintColumns: (state, getters) => {
    const tasks = getters.sprintBoardChats
    return $storex.chats.statusList.map((status, ix) => {
      const columnTasks = tasks
        .filter(t => t.status === status.value)
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const ao = a.sort_index ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
          const bo = b.sort_index ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
          if (ao !== bo) return ao - bo
          return (a.updated_at || '') < (b.updated_at || '') ? 1 : -1
        })

      return {
        id: status.value,
        value: status.value,
        title: status.label,
        icon: status.icon,
        textColor: status.textColor,
        borderColor: status.borderColor,
        position: ix,
        tasks: columnTasks
      }
    })
  },

  childBoards: (state, getters) => {
    return getters.allBoards.filter(b => b.parent_id === state.activeBoard)
  },

  parentBoard: (state, getters) => {
    const active = getters.activeKanbanBoard
    return getters.allBoards.find(b => b.id === active?.parent_id) || null
  },

  parentBoardOptions: (_, getters) => getters.allBoards,

  bookmarkedBoards: (_, getters) => getters.allBoards.filter(b => b.bookmark),

  lastUpdatedTask: (_, getters) => {
    const tasks = getters.viewColumns.reduce((a, col) => a.concat(col.tasks || []), [])
    return tasks.sort((a, b) =>
      (a.updated_at || new Date(1900, 1, 1)) > (b.updated_at || new Date(1900, 1, 1)) ? -1 : 1
    )[0] || {}
  },

  isLoading: (state) => state.loadingChats > 0,
})

// ─── Mutations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const mutations = mutationTree(state, {
  setActiveBoard(state, boardName) {
    state.activeBoard = boardName || null
  },

  setFilter(state, filter) {
    state.filter = filter || null
  },

  incrementLoading(state) {
    state.loadingChats += 1
  },

  decrementLoading(state) {
    state.loadingChats = Math.max(0, state.loadingChats - 1)
  },

  updateBoard(state, { boardId, updates }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    if (kanban.boards[boardId]) {
      kanban.boards[boardId] = {
        ...kanban.boards[boardId],
        ...updates
      }
    }
  },

  deleteBoard(state, boardId) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    if (kanban.boards[boardId]) {
      delete kanban.boards[boardId]
    }
  },

  addColumn(state, { boardId, column }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    const board = kanban.boards[boardId]
    if (board) {
      board.columns = [...(board.columns || []), column]
      board.last_update = new Date().toISOString()
    }
  },

  updateColumn(state, { boardId, columnId, updates }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    const board = kanban.boards[boardId]
    if (board?.columns) {
      const col = board.columns.find(c => c.id === columnId || c.title === updates.title)
      if (col) {
        Object.assign(col, updates)
        board.last_update = new Date().toISOString()
      }
    }
  },

  removeColumn(state, { boardId, columnTitle }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    const board = kanban.boards[boardId]
    if (board?.columns) {
      board.columns = board.columns.filter(c => c.title !== columnTitle)
      board.last_update = new Date().toISOString()
    }
  },

  reorderColumns(state, { boardId, columns }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    const board = kanban.boards[boardId]
    if (board) {
      board.columns = columns
      board.last_update = new Date().toISOString()
    }
  },

  setColumnsChats(state, { boardId, columnChats }) {
    const kanban = getKanban()
    const board = kanban.boards[boardId]
    if (board) {
      board.columns = board.columns?.map(col => ({
        ...col,
        chats: columnChats[col.title] || col.chats || []
      })) || []
      board.last_update = new Date().toISOString()
    }
  },
})

// ─── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const actions = actionTree(
  { state, getters, mutations },
  {
    async init() {
    },

    async onActiveProjectChanged() {
      // Called by projects store when activeProject changes
      mutations.setActiveBoard(state, null)
      mutations.setFilter(state, null)
      await $storex.kanban.loadKanban()
    },

    async setActiveBoard({ state }, boardName) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      if (!kanban || !kanban.boards) {
        await $storex.kanban.loadKanban()
      }
      const validBoard = boardName && getKanban().boards?.[boardName] ? boardName : null
      mutations.setActiveBoard(state, validBoard)
    },

    async loadKanban({ state }, project) {
      const targetProject = getActiveProject(project)
      if (!targetProject?.$api) return
      const kanban = await targetProject.$api.chats.kanban.load()
      if (!targetProject.$state) return
      targetProject.$state.kanban = kanban
      return kanban
    },

    async saveKanban({ state }, project) {
      const targetProject = getActiveProject(project)
      if (!targetProject?.$api) return
      const data = getKanban(targetProject)
      await targetProject.$api.chats.kanban.save(data)
    },

    async addColumn({ state }, { title, color, project_id }) {
      const board = getKanban().boards?.[state.activeBoard]
      if (!board) return
      title = title?.trim()
      if (!title) return

      const exists = board.columns?.find(c => c.title === title)
      if (exists) return

      mutations.addColumn(state, {
        boardId: state.activeBoard,
        column: {
          id: uuidv4(),
          title,
          color: color || null,
          project_id: project_id || null,
          chats: []
        }
      })
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
    },

    async updateColumn({ state }, { id, title, color, project_id }) {
      const board = getKanban().boards?.[state.activeBoard]
      if (!board) return

      mutations.updateColumn(state, {
        boardId: state.activeBoard,
        columnId: id,
        updates: {
          title: title?.trim(),
          color: color !== undefined ? color : undefined,
          project_id: project_id !== undefined ? project_id : undefined
        }
      })
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
    },

    async deleteColumn({ state, getters }, { title }) {
      const board = getKanban().boards?.[state.activeBoard]
      if (!board) return

      const col = getters.viewColumns.find(c => c.title === title)
      if (col?.tasks?.length) {
        await Promise.all(col.tasks.map(chat => $storex.chats.deleteChat(chat)))
      }

      mutations.removeColumn(state, {
        boardId: state.activeBoard,
        columnTitle: title
      })
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
    },

    async syncColumnOrder({ state, getters }, viewColumns) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      const board = kanban.boards?.[state.activeBoard]
      if (!board) return

      const newColumns = await Promise.all(
        viewColumns.map(async (viewCol) => {
          const storeCol = getters.activeKanbanBoard?.columns?.find(
            c => c.id === viewCol.id || c.title === viewCol.title
          ) || {}

          await Promise.all(
            (viewCol.tasks || [])
              .filter(t => t.column !== viewCol.title)
              .map(task => $storex.chats.saveChatInfo({ ...task, column: viewCol.title }))
          )

          return {
            id: storeCol.id || viewCol.id,
            title: viewCol.title,
            color: storeCol.color || viewCol.color || null,
            project_id: storeCol.project_id || viewCol.project_id || null,
            showSubTasks: storeCol.showSubTasks,
            chats: (viewCol.tasks || []).map(t => t.id)
          }
        })
      )

      mutations.reorderColumns(state, {
        boardId: state.activeBoard,
        columns: newColumns
      })
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
    },

    async moveTask({ state, getters }, { taskId, toColumn }) {
      const task = getters.boardChats.find(t => t.id === taskId)
      if (!task) return
      await $storex.chats.saveChatInfo({ ...task, column: toColumn })
    },

    // Persist a new task order within a column using sort_index on each chat
    async reorderTasksInColumn({ state, getters }, { columnTitle, taskIds }) {
      const tasks = getters.boardChats.filter(t => t.column === columnTitle)
      await Promise.all(
        taskIds.map((id, index) => {
          const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === id)
          if (!task) return Promise.resolve()
          return $storex.chats.saveChatInfo({ ...task, sort_index: index })
        })
      )
    },

    async newTask({ state }, { mode, column, name, profiles, board, llm_model }) {
      const activeProject = $storex.projects.activeProject
      const chat = await $storex.chats.createNewChat({
        id: uuidv4(),
        mode: mode || 'chat',
        profiles: profiles || [],
        messages: [],
        name: name || null,
        board: board || state.activeBoard,

    // ── Sprint actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    // Create a board of type 'sprint' (columns are implicit statuses)
    async createSprintBoard({ state }, { title, description } = {}) {

        description,
        type: 'sprint'
      })
    },

    // Move a task across sprint columns → writes chat.status (NOT chat.column)
    async moveSprintStatus({ state }, { taskId, status } = {}) {

      const chat = $storex.chats.chats?.[taskId]
      if (!chat) return
      if ((chat.status || 'todo') === status) return
      await $storex.chats.updateChatInfo({ chat, updates: { status } })

    // Add existing tasks to the active sprint (adds the board id to chat.sprints)
    async addTasksToSprint({ state }, { taskIds } = {}) {
      const sprintId = state.activeBoard
      if (!sprintId || !taskIds?.length) return

      await Promise.all(taskIds.map(async (id) => {
        const chat = $storex.chats.chats?.[id]
        if (!chat) return
        if ((chat.sprints || []).includes(sprintId)) return
        const sprints = Array.from(new Set([...(chat.sprints || []), sprintId]))
        await $storex.chats.updateChatInfo({ chat, updates: { sprints } })

    },

    async removeTaskFromSprint({ state }, { taskId } = {}) {

      const chat = $storex.chats.chats?.[taskId]
      if (!sprintId || !chat) return
      const sprints = (chat.sprints || []).filter(id => id !== sprintId)
      await $storex.chats.updateChatInfo({ chat, updates: { sprints } })
    },

    async newSprintTask({ state }, { name, status, mode, profiles, llm_model, parentId } = {}) {
      const sprintId = state.activeBoard

      const parentChat = parentId ? $storex.chats.chats?.[parentId] : null

      const chat = await $storex.chats.createNewChat({

        name: name || null,

        owner_project_id: parentChat?.owner_project_id || activeProject?.project_id || null,
        project_id: parentChat?.project_id || null,
      })

      // Defensive: guarantee membership/status via the metadata endpoint even if
      // the create payload path ignored those fields.
      if (chat?.id) {
        await $storex.chats.updateChatInfo({
          chat,
          updates: { sprints: [sprintId], status: status || 'todo' }
        })

        id: uuidv4(),
        board: parent.board,
        name,
        mode,
        profiles: profiles || [],
        column: column || parent.column,
        parent_id: parent_id || parent.id,
        message_id,
        project_id: project_id || parent.project_id,
        owner_project_id: parent.owner_project_id || parent.project_id,
        messages: description ? [{ role: 'user', content: description }] : [],
        file_list,
        child_index
      })

      if (activateChat !== false) {
        await $storex.chats.setActiveChat(chat)
      }

      await $storex.chats.saveChat(chat)
      if (description) $storex.projects.chatWihProject(chat)

    },

    async addBoard({ state }, { title, description, background, parent_id, project_id, columns, type }) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      if (!kanban) return

      title = title?.trim()
      if (!title || kanban.boards?.[title]) return

      if (!kanban.boards) kanban.boards = {}
      kanban.boards[title] = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        title,
        type: type || 'kanban',
        description: description || '',
        background: background || '',
        parent_id: parent_id || null,
        project_id: project_id || null,
        columns: columns || [],
        last_update: new Date().toISOString()
      }

      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
      mutations.setActiveBoard(state, title)
      return kanban.boards[title]
    },

    async saveBoard({ state }, { originalTitle, board }) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      const oldName = originalTitle
      const newName = board.title?.trim()
      if (!newName) return

      // Preserve board type (kanban | sprint) across edits and renames
      const boardType = board.type
        || kanban.boards?.[oldName]?.type
        || kanban.boards?.[newName]?.type
        || 'kanban'

      if (oldName && oldName !== newName) {
        const allChats = Object.values($storex.chats.chats || {})
        await Promise.all(
          allChats
            .filter(c => c.board === oldName)
            .map(c => $storex.chats.saveChatInfo({ ...c, board: newName }))
        )
        delete kanban.boards[oldName]
        Object.values(kanban.boards)
          .filter(b => b && b.parent_id === oldName)
          .forEach(b => (b.parent_id = newName))
      }

      kanban.boards[newName] = {
        ...kanban.boards[newName],
        title: newName,
        type: boardType,
        description: board.description || '',
        background: board.background || '',
        parent_id: board.parent_id || null,
        project_id: board.project_id || null
      }

      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()

      if (oldName && oldName !== newName && state.activeBoard === oldName) {
        mutations.setActiveBoard(state, newName)
      }
    },

    async deleteBoard({ state }, board) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      const boardTitle = board?.title || board
      if (!boardTitle || !kanban.boards?.[boardTitle]) return

      const boardChats = Object.values($storex.chats.chats || {})
        .filter(c => c.board === boardTitle)
      await Promise.all(boardChats.map(c => $storex.chats.deleteChat(c)))

      const childBoardsList = Object.values(kanban.boards)
        .filter(b => b && b.parent_id === boardTitle)
      for (const child of childBoardsList) {
        await $storex.kanban.deleteBoard(child)
      }

      mutations.deleteBoard(state, boardTitle)
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()

      if (state.activeBoard === boardTitle) {
        const fallback = board.parent_id || Object.keys(kanban.boards).find(k => kanban.boards[k] !== null) || null
        mutations.setActiveBoard(state, fallback)
      }
    },

    async toggleBookmark({ state }, boardTitle) {
      const kanban = getKanban()
      const board = kanban.boards?.[boardTitle || state.activeBoard]
      if (!board) return
      board.bookmark = !board.bookmark
      await $storex.kanban.saveKanban()
    },
  }
)

<script>
// Views exposed by this component
const VALID_VIEWS = ['board', 'planning', 'followup']

export default {
  props: {
    project: { type: Object, default: null },
    // Dockview/app panels receive the app params (e.g. { view: 'planning' }).
    // In router mode no prop is passed, so we also read the route query (?view=planning).
    params: { type: Object, default: () => ({}) }
  },
  data() {
    return {
      activeView: 'board',
      sidebarCompact: false,
      activeColumnFilter: 'all',
      selectedTaskId: null,
      searchQuery: '',
      editingColumn: null,
      showBoardList: false
    }
  },
  created() {
    if (this.requestedView) {
      this.activeView = this.requestedView
    }
    // Fall back to the board list only when the board view has no active board
    this.showBoardList = this.activeView === 'board' && !this.activeBoard?.title
  },
  computed: {
    // Resolve a requested initial view from app params (multiple shapes) or the route query
    requestedView() {
      const candidates = [
        this.params?.view,
        this.params?.params?.view,
        this.$route?.query?.view
      ]
      return candidates.find(v => VALID_VIEWS.includes(v)) || null
    },
    boards() {
      return this.$storex.kanban.allBoards
    },
    activeBoard() {
      return this.$storex.kanban.activeKanbanBoard
    },
    // Sprint boards replace the kanban canvas/sidebar with the sprint shell
    isSprintBoard() {
      return this.activeBoard?.type === 'sprint'
    },
    activeColumns() {
      return this.activeBoard?.columns || []
    },
    viewColumns() {
      return this.$storex.kanban.buildViewColumns(null)
    },
    filteredViewColumns() {
      if (this.activeColumnFilter === 'all') return this.viewColumns
      return this.viewColumns.filter(c => c.title === this.activeColumnFilter)
    },
    boardChats() {
      return this.$storex.kanban.boardChats
    },
    sidebarTasks() {
      const query = this.searchQuery?.toLowerCase()?.trim()
      const tasks = this.activeColumnFilter === 'all'
        ? this.boardChats
        : this.boardChats.filter(c => (c.column || '--none--') === this.activeColumnFilter)

      if (!query) return tasks

      return tasks.filter(task => {
        const inName = task.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        const inMessages = task.messages?.some(m => m.content?.toLowerCase().includes(query))
        const inFiles = task.file_list?.some(f => f.toLowerCase().includes(query))
        const inProfiles = task.profiles?.some(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(query))
        return inName || inMessages || inFiles || inProfiles
      })
    },
    viewTabs() {
      const planning = this.$storex.planning
      return [
        { id: 'board', label: 'Board', icon: 'fa-solid fa-columns', count: this.sidebarTasks.length },
        { id: 'planning', label: 'Planning', icon: 'fa-solid fa-list-check', count: planning?.allTasks?.length || 0 },
        { id: 'followup', label: 'Follow-up', icon: 'fa-solid fa-chart-line', count: planning?.metrics?.overdue || 0 }
      ]
    }
  },
  watch: {
    // Apply a view requested through params/route (e.g. /kanban?view=planning)
    requestedView(view) {
      this.activeView = view || 'board'
    },
    // Sprint boards only expose the board view — force it when one is selected
    activeBoard(board) {
      if (board?.type === 'sprint' && this.activeView !== 'board') {
        this.activeView = 'board'
      }
    },
    // Switching back to the board view without an active board shows the board list
    activeView(view) {
      if (view === 'board' && !this.activeBoard?.title) {
        this.showBoardList = true
      }
    },
    project() {
      this.selectedTaskId = null
      this.searchQuery = ''
      this.activeColumnFilter = 'all'
      this.showBoardList = false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    onSelectBoard(boardId) {
      this.$storex.kanban.setActiveBoard(boardId)
      this.selectedTaskId = null
      this.activeColumnFilter = 'all'
    },
    onSelectBoardFromList(boardTitle) {
      this.$storex.kanban.setActiveBoard(boardTitle)
      this.selectedTaskId = null
      this.activeColumnFilter = 'all'
      this.showBoardList = false
    },
    onBookmark(board) {
      this.$storex.kanban.toggleBookmark(board.title)
    },
    onToggleColumnFilter(colTitle) {
      this.activeColumnFilter = this.activeColumnFilter === colTitle ? 'all' : colTitle
    },
    onSelectTask(task) {
      this.selectedTaskId = task?.id || null
      if (task) {
        this.$chats.setActiveChat(task)
      }
    },
    onUpdateSearch(query) {
      this.searchQuery = query
    },
    openNewTaskModal(opts = {}) {
      this.$refs.modals?.openNewTask(opts)
    },
    openNewColumnModal() {
      this.editingColumn = null
      this.$refs.modals?.openNewColumn()
    },
    openNewBoardModal() {
      this.$refs.modals?.openNewBoard()
    },
    onEditColumn(colTitle) {
      const col = this.activeColumns.find(c => c.title === colTitle)
      this.editingColumn = col || null
      this.$refs.modals?.openNewColumn()
    },
    async onMoveTask({ taskId, toColumn }) {
      await this.$storex.kanban.moveTask({ taskId, toColumn })
    },
    async onReorderColumns(reorderedColumns) {
      await this.$storex.kanban.syncColumnOrder(reorderedColumns)
    },
    async onReorderTasks({ columnTitle, taskIds }) {
      await this.$storex.kanban.reorderTasksInColumn({ columnTitle, taskIds })
    },
    async onTaskCreated({ name, column, mode, profiles, llm_model }) {
      if (!name?.trim() || !this.activeBoard) return
      const chat = await this.$storex.kanban.newTask({ name, column, mode, profiles, llm_model })
      if (chat) {
        this.onSelectTask(chat)
      }
    },
    async onColumnCreated({ title, color }) {
      if (!title?.trim() || !this.activeBoard) return
      await this.$storex.kanban.addColumn({ title, color })
    },
    async onColumnUpdated({ id, title, color }) {
      if (!this.activeBoard) return
      await this.$storex.kanban.updateColumn({ id, title, color })
      this.editingColumn = null
    },
    async onBoardCreated({ title, description, type }) {
      if (!title?.trim()) return
      await this.$storex.kanban.addBoard({ title, description, type })
    }
  }
}

    closeNewTask() {
      this.showNewTask = false
    },
    confirmNewTask() {
      if (!this.newTask.name?.trim()) return
      this.$emit('task-created', {
        name: this.newTask.name,
        column: this.newTask.column,
        mode: this.newTask.mode,
        parentId: this.newTask.parentId || null,
        profiles: this.newTask.selectedProfiles.map(p => p.name),
        llm_model: this.newTask.llm_model || null
      })
      this.closeNewTask()
    },
    onProfilesChanged(profiles) {
      this.newTask.selectedProfiles = profiles || []
    },
    onModelChanged(modelName) {
      this.newTask.llm_model = modelName || null
    },

    // ── New Column ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    openNewColumn() {
      if (this.editingColumn) {
        this.newColumn = {
          id: this.editingColumn.id,
          title: this.editingColumn.title,
          color: this.editingColumn.color || '#6366f1'
        }
      } else {
        this.newColumn = { title: '', color: '#6366f1' }
      }
      this.columnError = null
      this.showNewColumn = true
      this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.colNameInput?.focus())
    },
    closeNewColumn() {
      this.showNewColumn = false
      this.columnError = null
    },
    confirmNewColumn() {
      const title = this.newColumn.title?.trim()
      if (!title) return

      const duplicate = this.columns.find(
        c => c.title === title && c.id !== this.newColumn.id
      )
      if (duplicate) {
        this.columnError = 'A column with this name already exists'
        return
      }

      if (this.editingColumn) {
        this.$emit('column-updated', { ...this.newColumn, title })
      } else {
        this.$emit('column-created', { title, color: this.newColumn.color })
      }
      this.closeNewColumn()
    },

    // ── New Board ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    openNewBoard() {
      this.newBoard = DEFAULT_NEW_BOARD()
      this.showNewBoard = true
      this.$nextTick(() => this.$refs.boardNameInput?.focus())
    },
    closeNewBoard() {
      this.showNewBoard = false
    },
    confirmNewBoard() {
      if (!this.newBoard.title?.trim()) return
      this.$emit('board-created', { ...this.newBoard })
      this.closeNewBoard()
    }
  }
}
</script>

      isDragOver: false,
      draggingTaskId: null
    }

  methods: {
    onDragOver() {
      this.isDragOver = true
    },
    onDragLeave() {
      this.isDragOver = false
    },
    onDragStart(event, task) {
      this.draggingTaskId = task.id
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move'
      event.dataTransfer.setData('sprintTaskId', task.id)
      event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', task.id)
    },
    onDragEnd() {
      this.draggingTaskId = null
      this.isDragOver = false
    },

      const taskId = event.dataTransfer.getData('sprintTaskId')
        || event.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain')
      // Guard: dropping a card back on its own column is a no-op
      const isOwnActiveDrag = this.draggingTaskId && this.draggingTaskId === taskId
      this.isDragOver = false
      this.draggingTaskId = null
      if (!taskId || isOwnActiveDrag) return
      this.$emit('move-task', { taskId, status: this.column.value })
    }
  }
}

<script>
const PAGE_SIZE = 40

export default {
  props: {
    boards: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    activeBoard: { type: Object, default: null },
    columns: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    activeColumnFilter: { type: String, default: 'all' },
    tasks: { type: Array, default: () => [] },
    selectedTaskId: { type: String, default: null },
    isCompact: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    searchQuery: { type: String, default: '' }
  },
  emits: ['select-board', 'toggle-column-filter', 'select-task', 'new-task', 'new-board', 'new-column', 'update-search', 'toggle-compact', 'show-board-list'],
  data() {
    return {
      visiblePage: 1,
      scrollObserver: null
    }
  },
  computed: {
    allChats() {
      return Object.values(this.$storex.chats.chats || {})
    },
    // Map board id -> latest task updated_at for sorting
    boardActivityMap() {
      const map = {}
      this.allChats.forEach(chat => {
        const ts = chat.updated_at || chat.created_at || null
        if (!ts) return
        const keys = [chat.board, ...(chat.sprints || [])].filter(Boolean)
        keys.forEach(key => {
          if (!map[key] || ts > map[key]) map[key] = ts
        })
      })
      return map
    },
    // Boards sorted by latest task activity descending
    sortedBoards() {
      return [...this.boards].sort((a, b) => {
        const aTs = this.boardActivityMap[a.id] || a.last_update || ''
        const bTs = this.boardActivityMap[b.id] || b.last_update || ''
        return aTs > bTs ? -1 : aTs < bTs ? 1 : 0
      })
    },
    groupedTasks() {
      // Only group when showing ALL columns with no search
      if (this.activeColumnFilter !== 'all' || this.searchQuery) return null

      const groups = {}
      const pageLimit = this.visiblePage * PAGE_SIZE
      let rendered = 0

      this.columns.forEach(col => {
        const colTasks = this.tasks.filter(t => (t.column || '--none--') === col.title)
        if (colTasks.length) {
          const slice = colTasks.slice(0, Math.max(0, pageLimit - rendered))
          if (slice.length) groups[col.title] = slice
          rendered += colTasks.length
        }
      })

      // Tasks with no matching column
      const knownCols = new Set(this.columns.map(c => c.title))
      const orphans = this.tasks.filter(t => !knownCols.has(t.column || '--none--'))
      if (orphans.length) {
        groups['Other'] = orphans.slice(0, Math.max(0, pageLimit - rendered))
      }

      return Object.keys(groups).length ? groups : null
    },
    // For flat list (filtered by column or search), paginated
    visibleFlatTasks() {
      return this.tasks.slice(0, this.visiblePage * PAGE_SIZE)
    },
    totalVisibleCount() {
      if (this.groupedTasks) {
        return Object.values(this.groupedTasks).reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.length, 0)
      }
      return this.visibleFlatTasks.length
    },
    hasMorePages() {
      return this.totalVisibleCount < this.tasks.length
    }
  },
  watch: {
    tasks() {
      // Reset pagination when task list changes
      this.visiblePage = 1
    },
    activeColumnFilter() {
      this.visiblePage = 1
    },
    searchQuery() {
      this.visiblePage = 1
    },
    isCompact(compact) {
      if (!compact) {
        this.$nextTick(() => this.setupScrollObserver())
      } else {
        this.teardownScrollObserver()
      }
    }
  },
  mounted() {
    this.setupScrollObserver()
  },
  beforeUnmount() {
    this.teardownScrollObserver()
  },
  methods: {
    boardTaskCount(boardId) {
      const board = this.boards.find(b => b.id === boardId)
      const isSprint = board?.type === 'sprint'
      return this.allChats.filter(c => isSprint
        ? (c.sprints || []).includes(boardId)
        : c.board === boardId
      ).length
    },
    getColumnColor(colTitle) {
      const col = this.columns.find(c => c.title === colTitle)
      return col?.color || null
    },
    onAllColumnsClick() {
      if (this.activeColumnFilter !== 'all') {
        this.$emit('toggle-column-filter', this.activeColumnFilter)
      }
    },
    setupScrollObserver() {
      this.teardownScrollObserver()
      const sentinel = this.$refs.scrollSentinel
      if (!sentinel) return

      this.scrollObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries) => {
          if (entries[0]?.isIntersecting && this.hasMorePages) {
            this.visiblePage += 1
          }
        },
        {
          root: this.$refs.taskListEl || null,
          threshold: 0.1
        }
      )
      this.scrollObserver.observe(sentinel)
    },
    teardownScrollObserver() {
      if (this.scrollObserver) {
        this.scrollObserver.disconnect()
        this.scrollObserver = null
      }
    }
  }
}

export default {
  props: {

      default: null

    project: {
      type: Object,
      default: null
    },
    options: {
      type: Object,
      default: () => ({})
    }
  },
  data() {
    return {
      boardFilter: ''
    }
  },
  computed: {
    allStoredBoards() {
      // Use storex.kanban as the source of truth
      return this.$storex.kanban.allBoards || []
    },
    displayBoards() {
      if (this.boards && Array.isArray(this.boards) && this.boards.length > 0) {
        return this.boards
      }
      return this.allStoredBoards
    },
    allChats() {
      return Object.values(this.$storex.chats.chats || {})
    },
    chatMap() {
      const map = {}
      this.allChats.forEach(chat => {
        map[chat.id] = chat
      })
      return map
    },
    // Map board title -> latest task updated_at (board for kanban, membership for sprint)
    boardActivityMap() {
      const map = {}
      this.allChats.forEach(chat => {
        const ts = chat.updated_at || chat.created_at || null
        if (!ts) return
        const keys = [chat.board, ...(chat.sprints || [])].filter(Boolean)
        keys.forEach(key => {
          if (!map[key] || ts > map[key]) map[key] = ts
        })
      })
      return map
    },
    bookmarks() {
      return this.displayBoards.filter(b => b.bookmark && this.matchesFilter(b))
    },
    rootBoards() {
      if (this.boards && Array.isArray(this.boards)) {
        return this.boards
      }
      const allBoardIds = this.allStoredBoards.map(b => b.id)
      return this.allStoredBoards.filter(b => !allBoardIds.includes(b.parent_id))
    },
    filteredBoards() {
      if (!this.boardFilter) return this.rootBoards
      return this.rootBoards.filter(board => this.matchesFilter(board))
    },
    sortedBoards() {
      return this.filteredBoards
        .filter(b => !b.bookmark)
        .sort((a, b) => {
          // Sort by latest task activity first, fallback to board last_update
          const aTs = this.boardActivityMap[a.title] || a.last_update || ''
          const bTs = this.boardActivityMap[b.title] || b.last_update || ''
          return aTs > bTs ? -1 : aTs < bTs ? 1 : 0
        })
    }
  },
  methods: {
    boardLastActivity(board) {
      return this.boardActivityMap[board.title] || board.last_update || null
    },
    boardTaskCount(board) {
      const isSprint = board?.type === 'sprint'
      return this.allChats.filter(c => isSprint
        ? (c.sprints || []).includes(board.title)
        : c.board === board.title
      ).length
    },
    matchesFilter(board) {
      const filterLower = this.boardFilter.toLowerCase()

      if (board.title && board.title.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)) {
        return true
      }

      if (board.columns && Array.isArray(board.columns)) {
        if (board.columns.some(col =>
          col.title && col.title.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)
        )) {
          return true
        }
      }

      if (board.columns && Array.isArray(board.columns)) {
        for (const column of board.columns) {
          if (column.chats && Array.isArray(column.chats)) {
            for (const chatId of column.chats) {
              const chat = this.chatMap[chatId]
              if (chat && this.chatMatches(chat, filterLower)) {
                return true
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Sprint boards: match tasks that belong to the sprint
      if (board.type === 'sprint') {
        const sprintChats = this.allChats.filter(c => (c.sprints || []).includes(board.title))
        if (sprintChats.some(chat => this.chatMatches(chat, filterLower))) {
          return true
        }
      }

      return false
    },
    chatMatches(chat, filterLower) {
      if (!chat) return false

      if (chat.name && chat.name.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)) {
        return true
      }

      if (chat.file_list?.some(f => f.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower))) {
        return true
      }

      if (chat.messages && Array.isArray(chat.messages)) {
        return chat.messages.some(msg =>
          (msg.content && msg.content.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)) ||
          (msg.think && msg.think.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)) ||
          (msg.files && msg.files.some(f => f.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)))
        )
      }

      return false
    },
    getMatchingContent(board) {
      const filterLower = this.boardFilter.toLowerCase()
      const matchingColumns = []
      let chatCount = 0

      if (board.columns && Array.isArray(board.columns)) {
        for (const column of board.columns) {
          let columnMatches = false

          if (column.title && column.title.toLowerCase().includes(filterLower)) {
            matchingColumns.push(column.title)
            columnMatches = true
          }

          if (column.chats && Array.isArray(column.chats)) {
            for (const chatId of column.chats) {
              const chat = this.chatMap[chatId]
              if (chat && this.chatMatches(chat, filterLower)) {
                chatCount++
                if (!columnMatches) {
                  matchingColumns.push(column.title)
                  columnMatches = true
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      return {
        columns: [...new Set(matchingColumns)],
        chatCount
      }
    },
    selectBoard(board) {
      this.$emit('select', board.title)
    },
    openRemoteBoard(board) {
      window.open(board.remote_url, '_blank')
    },
    toggleBookmark(board) {
      this.$emit('bookmark', board)
    }
  }
}
</script>
